WhitemaneZealPityTheFrail.name: Pity the Frail
WhitemaneZealPityTheFrail.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

WhitemaneSearingLashRighteousFlame.name: Righteous Flame
WhitemaneSearingLashRighteousFlame.description: Searing Lash deals 25% more damage to enemies. If the second strike hits an enemy Hero, they take an additional 25% damage and Whitemane gains 40% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

WhitemaneInquisitorsPrayer.name: Inquisitor's Prayer
WhitemaneInquisitorsPrayer.description: Searing Lash restores 25 Mana for each Hero it hits, and Zeal lasts 2 additional seconds.

WhitemaneDesperatePleaUnwaveringFaith.name: Unwavering Faith
WhitemaneDesperatePleaUnwaveringFaith.description: Increase Whitemane's Basic Attack range by 1.1. Whitemane gains 20% increased Basic Attack damage for each active Zeal buff.

WhitemaneDesperatePleaMartyrdom.name: Martyrdom
WhitemaneDesperatePleaMartyrdom.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

WhitemaneZealIndulgence.name: Indulgence
WhitemaneZealIndulgence.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Increase this by an additional 5% for each active Zeal.

WhitemaneDesperatePleaZealousSpirit.name: Zealous Spirit
WhitemaneDesperatePleaZealousSpirit.description: Upon reaching 2 stacks of Desperation, Whitemane gains Zeal.

WhitemaneSaintlyGreatstaff.name: Saintly Greatstaff
WhitemaneSaintlyGreatstaff.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Searing Lash are marked for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 55 Spell damage and remove the mark.

WhitemaneIntercession.name: Intercession
WhitemaneIntercession.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

WhitemaneScarletAegis.name: Scarlet Aegis
WhitemaneScarletAegis.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

WhitemaneDivineReckoning.name: Divine Reckoning
WhitemaneDivineReckoning.description: After 1 second, consecrate an area for 4 seconds, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies inside. 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes is returned as Mana.

WhitemaneInquisitionSubjugation.name: Subjugation
WhitemaneInquisitionSubjugation.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

WhitemaneSearingLashLashingOut.name: Lashing Out
WhitemaneSearingLashLashingOut.description: If Searing Lash's second strike hits an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown to 1 second.

WhitemaneZealScarletWrath.name: Scarlet Wrath
WhitemaneZealScarletWrath.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the duration of all active Zeals by 0.75 seconds, restore 1% Mana to all Zeal targets, and lower the cooldown of Zeals activation by 4 seconds.

WhitemaneDesperatePleaRadiance.name: Radiance
WhitemaneDesperatePleaRadiance.description: Reaching 3 stacks of Desperation heals for 190 and reapplies Zeal to allies with Zeal.

WhitemaneInquisitionSharedPunishment.name: Shared Punishment
WhitemaneInquisitionSharedPunishment.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

WhitemaneSearingLashHarshDiscipline.name: Harsh Discipline
WhitemaneSearingLashHarshDiscipline.description: Hitting a Hero with Searing Lash while they are being targeted by Inquisition Roots them for 1.5 seconds. Passive: Reduce Inquisition's cooldown by 2 seconds.

WhitemaneScarletAegisScarletCrusade.name: Scarlet Crusade
WhitemaneScarletAegisScarletCrusade.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

WhitemaneDivineReckoningJudgmentDay.name: Judgment Day
WhitemaneDivineReckoningJudgmentDay.description: Divine Reckoning deals 50% more damage and pulls enemies to its center the first time it hits them.

WhitemaneGuidingLight.name: Guiding Light
WhitemaneGuidingLight.description: Activate to cast a permanent Zeal on an allied Hero that costs no Mana and doesn't grant Desperation. Only one can be active at a time and has global cast range. Increases the Spell Power bonus provided by Whitemane's trait by 15%.

WhitemanePurgeTheWicked.name: Purge the Wicked
WhitemanePurgeTheWicked.description: Activate to blast an enemy Hero with holy fire, reducing their Armor by 25 and dealing 300 damage over 4 seconds.
